mostWorthwhile.text: Testing Asha's unfinished request and correction was most worthwhile: it showed the link working in both directions without confusing receipt with completion.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the gateway through several successive setup steps felt a little procedural, even though the access boundaries had a clear purpose.

surprise.text: Tin Row's CLOSED meant RECEIVED rather than completed, a small wording difference with serious consequences for requests.

arbitrary.text: No action felt notably arbitrary; even the sign contributed to making the shared passage usable.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the two communities use their connection, especially after the successful correction test and shared passage.
